'''Hercules' Arrow''' was an ancient artifact that resided on the [[Argo]] after it was sunk just off the shores of [[Sutos]].
== History ==
Whilst diving down to the [[Argo]] to recover Jason's [[Hoplite]] [[Amulets]], [[Zhalia Moon]] encountered the Hercules' Arrow among other items including the [[Golden Fleece]] and [[Apple of Paris]]. Placing a coin on the pedestal of the Golden Fleece unlocked the vault, as it was that that Jason has been after on his quest, allowing her to recover the chest of [[Dragon's teeth]] and the Amulets of the Hoplite Titans. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}
